Crimes against humanity: 2 Al-Badr leaders arrested in Tangail
2022-03-04T14:14:36+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/crime-justice/news/crimes-against-humanity-2-al-badr-leaders-arrested-tangail-2975466

Police have arrested two Al-Badr leaders in Gopalpur upazila of Tangail for their alleged involvement in crimes against humanity and genocide during the Liberation War.

The arrestees are Moniruzzaman Kohinur of Beradakuri village of Jhawail union and Alamgir Hossain Talukdar of Chatutia village, of the upazila.

Kohinur was arrested from Dhaka and Alamgir from Gopalpur last night, Matiur Rahman, investigation officer and deputy director of the International Crimes Tribunal, told our Tangail correspondent.

Police have handed over the arrestees to the tribunal, said the IO.

"They were local Al-Badr leaders. An allegation of involvement in crimes against humanity and genocide during 1971 Liberation War has been brought against them," he added.
